archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury - Dark) - Modified for Raw Intimacy & Emotional Weight
design_philosophy: This is not a 'wellness app'. It is a sanctuary. No pastel gradients, no cheerful blobs, no gamification. The app must feel like a quiet, protected room at 2am. It embraces isolation to provide comfort. We rely on pure black void spaces, elegant melancholic typography, and excruciatingly slow, deliberate motion to ground the user.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use 2-3x more padding than usual to create physical distance around elements, reinforcing the 'Empty Room' metaphor.
spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto h-screen flex flex-col relative

motion.philosophy: Breathing cadence. Transitions should feel like slow inhales and exhales.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-inverse px-8 py-4 rounded-none font-mono text-xs tracking-widest uppercase hover:bg-white transition-colors duration-300
buttons.ghost: text-secondary hover:text-primary px-4 py-2 text-sm transition-colors duration-500
buttons.icon: p-4 rounded-full border border-subtle hover:border-focus transition-all duration-500 flex items-center justify-center text-primary

inputs.void_text: bg-transparent border-none text-2xl font-headings text-center w-full focus:ring-0 text-primary placeholder:text-muted resize-none leading-relaxed

SplashScreen.layout: Flex-col, centered, absolute black background with subtle noise texture overlay.
SplashScreen.details: A single mono-spaced text 'NoOneListening.' slowly fades in. A primary button 'ENTER THE ROOM' beneath it. On click, generates a random ID (e.g., 'ID: 48F2-9A') in mono text before transitioning.

HomeScreen.layout: Bento-style split screen or two massive typographic blocks taking 50vh each.
HomeScreen.details: Top half: 'Empty Room' (Just me, venting into the void). Bottom half: 'Echo' (I want someone to listen). Hovering/Pressing expands the section and fades the other.

EmptyRoomScreen.layout: Extremely minimal. Just a recording indicator at bottom, a large invisible text area in the middle.
EmptyRoomScreen.details: Audio: Pulsing 1px thin soundwave in the center. Text: When user types and hits enter, the text block floats up and slowly dissolves (opacity 0, blur) into the background over 4 seconds (cathartic release).

AIChatScreen.layout: Not a standard chat UI. No chat bubbles.
AIChatScreen.details: User messages are right-aligned, muted, mono-spaced. AI responses are left-aligned, large serif text (Cormorant Garamond). Mood Badges are tiny pills (e.g., [ ↳ Melancholic ]) placed subtly above the AI's response paragraph using the mood_badges color palette.

FarewellScreen.layout: Centered emotive text on a dark textured background.
FarewellScreen.details: Text: 'You survived today. Tomorrow is another.' Toggle for 'Remind me tomorrow' uses a custom thin minimalist switch. A ghost button 'Leave' to exit.

ExitModal.layout: Full screen heavy backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/80).
ExitModal.details: Triggered when hitting the 'Close' icon. Large serif text: 'Are you feeling better?' Options: 'Yes, I am' / 'Not yet, I need to stay'. Completely removes the user from the outside world.

images.description: Subtle dark texture with slight lighting, used for the Splash Screen and Farewell Screen backgrounds with low opacity.
Dark cinematic architecture with mist, used for the Empty Room background at 10% opacity to create spatial depth without distraction.
Intricate dark fabric texture, providing warmth and safety to the AI Chat screen.

media.soundwave_instructions: Do not use chunky bars for the mic visualizer. Use SVG or Canvas to draw 3-5 thin (1px) curved lines that expand vertically based on an active state. They should look like a delicate heartbeat or a thread caught in the wind.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark, muted color palette. Do not inject bright or standard 'Tailwind blue' default colors anywhere.
Ensure headings use Cormorant Garamond and body uses IBM Plex Sans. Include Google Fonts links in the index.html or layout wrapper.
Implement the 'dissolving text' in Empty Room carefully. It requires tracking an array of typed messages and setting a timeout to add a 'dissolve' CSS class that triggers the slow opacity-0 blur.
Use Shadcn UI sparingly; heavily override any card or button components to remove radii, thick borders, or standard dropshadows. Rely on 1px borders and pure flat surfaces.
The app must be responsive but optimized for mobile view (max-w-md mx-auto) as per the requirement 'mobile app... web preview'.
Implement the mood badges strictly using the colors defined in the JSON. They should look like tiny technical logs alongside the humanistic serif AI text.
Never use generic placeholder images. Use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs.
